title: Proportion gives shared work dependable form

captions.energy: Joining differences into a living rhythm
captions.emotions: Calm support within a shared structure

meaning: A proportionate joining of different capacities can inspire fair decisions and a sense of dependable shared support.
text: Different capacities can serve a purpose close to you both. Temperance in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to join them within a living, proportionate rhythm. Justice in the physical position describes shared actions: stating conditions, comparing obligations with resources and considering consequences. The Emperor in emotions brings calm support within a shared structure. It feels rewarding that clear agreements hold something useful together and make it accessible without people needing particular favour from organisers or guessing who is responsible. The arrangement can serve a wider circle because practical clarity allows different contributions to coexist.

For example, you help arrange borrowing of communal gardening tools. Together, you establish collection times, an understandable return period and arrangements for replacing something broken. **Fair proportion gives shared usefulness a stable form.** A new neighbour can readily borrow the spade they need and return it on time. Calm pleasure concerns your contribution allowing different people to care for a shared courtyard with predictability and respect for actual capacities.

It becomes harder if a balance once found becomes the only permitted arrangement. Seasons change and people have different available hours, yet conditions still demand an earlier alignment. A connecting motive and sense of support remain positive. Responsibility stays alive when clear rules can recognise changed capacities without making preservation of the arrangement itself the main purpose of participation.
